name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-07-10, at wavelengths from 1.37 to 4.73 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
